_comment: Philips Hue RGB spotlights (4 at the cardinal points) driven by the scene lighting model. Disabled by default. To enable: pair the bridge (press the link button, POST to /api to get an app key), then set enabled=true, bridge_host to the bridge IP, app_key to that key, and cardinals to your light ids (Hue v1 ids are strings). ZigBee is NOT streamed — each lighting change sends one PUT per light with a native transitiontime and the bulb fades itself. See scripts/hue_controller.gd and DESIGN.md §8 (v0.17).
